clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Laris Geardawdle studies how corruption changes living matter. A Filled Pure Sample Jar holds primordial ooze gathered from the remote wilds, giving him an uncorrupted specimen for comparison.

Laris Geardawdle studies oozes across Azeroth and how corruption changes living matter. He found that these shapeless creatures absorb and reflect the magic and conditions of their homes. After cataloging tainted slimes in Felwood, he sought a clean sample to compare with them. A Filled Pure Sample Jar holds primordial ooze gathered from the wilds of Un'Goro Crater, where it can be studied apart from corrupted strains.

Oozes change readily, so Laris cannot find pure samples near civilization, demonic blights, or necromantic fallout. The glutinous oozes of Un'Goro Crater's untamed basin remain relatively isolated from outside corruption, making them a useful standard for scholars in Ironforge.
